method: Independent full frozen-source audit. Runtime noBake on BODY+skirt only; try/finally registry restoration; explicit actual hero IDs; actual dynamic nose/muzzle/smile-or-mouthO surface depth probes; actual current buildCat3D/POSES phase=0/yaw=32; body outline vertex expansion; independent normal bake FRAME by applyBoneTransform on every vertex; 12x12 actual baked eye-core triangle projection plus five face landmark depth probes; baseline only body replaced from e777d58f3b0e9965f7af25ded73948a84e68d219, identical current engines

runtimeSnapshot.temporaryPhysicalMetadata: Only non-enumerable read-only actual geometry/local-matrix references captured before normal bake; no geometry, transforms, materials, bones or draw nodes changed.

finiteScope.eyeDepth: 12x12 samples over actual baked eye-core triangles with their current scale and projected frontmost triangle depth; sample ID set differences, not count/case equality. Dynamic hurt squint and blink included.
finiteScope.faceDepth: Five actual projected surface points: nose, two active smile or mouthO points, two muzzle points. Mouth selection follows current applyPose scale; frontmost face triangle depth, not fixed head coordinates.
finiteScope.skull: 1120 real posed skull triangles, convex halfspaces; owned solid and expanded outline triangles clipped against strict interior (1e-6), including crossing triangles with zero inside vertices. Pose/time intersections cached across rigid yaw rotations.
finiteScope.limits: Finite pose/time/yaw samples cannot establish every continuous instant. Existing frame clipping is recorded as equal between baseline and candidate; this report does not claim all characters fit the frame. Conservative face depth checks compare clothing against the facial surface; they do not by themselves classify clothing hidden behind other opaque head geometry.

compactCaseSchema.eyeSampleId: eyeIndex*144 + xi*12 + yi, xi and yi are 0..11; convert to concrete eye:xi,yi

rawAudit.keptTemporaryReason: Full repeated mesh diagnostics and dynamic sample coordinates exceed the per-file 500000 byte repository cap. Compact rows retain every state, eye sample IDs, face sample IDs, expression mode, clipping and skull triangle results.

visualReview.references: Read nine original hero JPGs via contact sheet; shape and palette checked against actual source references.
visualReview.result: Normal same-engine before/after shows Wei lamellae, light X straps, short open vest and front woven rattan clearly. No new visible face obstruction in reviewed six representative idle panels.
visualReview.leastSatisfied: 190px woven rattan loses small alternating over/under depth; rear surface remains plain warm woven-color shell. Existing weapon or headgear issues are outside these four clothes.
